THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
ROMANTIC GEOMETRY
042
56 / Winter Square
A snowy selfie in a historic city square: long straight
blonde hair, blue eyes and windburnt pink cheeks under a black
fur ushanka hat, with a black wool coat and black leather gloves.
A colorful onion-domed cathedral and a red-brick tower rise
behind her under an overcast sky.
57 / Golden Collar
A warm, glossy close-up against a black background:
voluminous dark curly hair, brown eyes with smoky liner,
glowing skin, rosy-nude lips, long gold drop earrings and a
graduated bib necklace of fine gold bead chains scattered with
small crystals, worn with a pale blue satin top.
